actions.askAi.description: Ask AI to analyze, explain, draft or decide using your flow data.
actions.askAi.props.aiProviderModel.desc: A tier your admin set up, or a specific model.
actions.askAi.props.conversationKey.desc: Same key in this flow continues the chat. Empty starts fresh.
actions.askAi.props.creativity.descripti: From 0 to 100. Lower is focused, higher is creative.
actions.askAi.props.maxOutputTokens.desc: Longest reply allowed, in tokens. Raise it if a long reply fails or stops short.
actions.askAi.props.webSearch.descriptio: Let the AI search the web before it answers.
actions.classifyText.description: Sort text into one of your categories to branch the flow.
actions.classifyText.props.aiProviderMod: A tier your admin set up, or a specific model.
actions.classifyText.props.categories.de: The AI picks exactly one of these.
actions.extractStructuredData.descriptio: Pull names, amounts and other fields from text, images or PDFs.
actions.extractStructuredData.props.aiPr: A tier your admin set up, or a specific model.
actions.extractStructuredData.props.file: Images or PDFs to extract from.
actions.extractStructuredData.props.maxO: Longest reply allowed, in tokens. Raise it if a long reply fails or stops short.
actions.extractStructuredData.props.prom: Extra guidance for the AI, like a date format to use.
actions.extractStructuredData.props.text: Text to extract from. Fill this, Files, or both.
actions.generateImage.description: Create or edit images from a text description.
Images to edit or combine. Not every model accepts them.
actions.run_agent.description: Let an agent use tools and work step by step until the task is done.
actions.run_agent.props.agentId.descript: Run a saved agent. Its instructions, tools and model come from the agent itself, so improving it improves every flow that uses it.
Leave empty when the step runs a saved agent: the model comes from the agent.
actions.run_agent.props.maxSteps.descrip: Maximum number of steps before the agent stops.
actions.run_agent.props.prompt.descripti: Describe what you want the agent to do.
actions.summarizeText.description: Summarize long emails, articles, or documents into what matters.
actions.summarizeText.props.aiProviderMo: A tier your admin set up, or a specific model.
actions.summarizeText.props.maxOutputTok: Longest reply allowed, in tokens. Raise it if a long reply fails or stops short.
actions.summarizeText.props.prompt.descr: How to summarize. Edit it to change length, tone or focus.
description: Ask, summarize, classify, extract and create images with AI.
